source: Written for VPM to the upstream package's API and behavior. Emotion's tests are retained in scripts/emotion-conformance/upstream (repository commit 49229553967b6050c92d9602eb577bdc48167e91, tag @emotion/styled@11.14.1).
changes: Written for VPM: MurmurHash2 with Math.imul, one pass over the string.

Characters beyond ASCII are hashed as their UTF-8 bytes (lone surrogates as their own code points); @emotion/hash kept only each code unit's low byte, so characters with the same low byte (中 and 伭, Ā and NUL) hashed alike and two styles differing only by them got the same class name. ASCII strings hash exactly as before.
UTF-8 is encoded without TextEncoder, which jsdom test environments lack.

verification.upstreamSuite: Emotion's 293 tests (hash, weak-memoize, sheet, cache, react, styled) pass with this package in place of the original, in development and production builds.
